text: I feel a quiet curiosity standing here, observing the clean lines of glass walls and the cool, orderly architecture. The room feels almost anticipatory, as if inviting thought and reflection about the intersection of safety, knowledge, and innovation. Entering the R+D space further nurtures a sense of invention and exploration; I am both spectator and participant in humanity’s ever-evolving conversation with technology and possibility. There is inspiration here, tinged with the subtle anxiety of confronting the unknown future.
